did: I made the episode thumbnails, from prototype to landed code. First I drew four template directions for every genre, then the four cases the owner judges by (the weekly call, the NixOS explainer, a Rust Rounds week, the interview essay), each at full size and at YouTube's smallest size, the same bytes every time. The owner picked C with D's footer band, in the genre's colour. I built it: every recorder now draws thumbnail.png beside the episode's video. The genre's shape sits behind the title, and a band says who speaks: a tin bird for the synthetic voice, the mochi and "+ me" where the owner's own voice is in it. The title comes from the episode's own facts, one rule per genre, and a title too long to read in YouTube's list gets no thumbnail rather than a bad one. The genre art moved into the shared styles, so Studio's rows and the thumbnails draw from one source. It landed in bucket 1 (#3398).

calls.title: Each genre's thumbnail title, made from its episode's facts
options: a rule per genre over the episode's facts
the cut list's own title, which repeats the genre
calls.why: The owner wants the title derived, never typed. Each rule reads what the recorder already holds: the call's week, the Rust week and its first ticket, the interview's role, a cards essay's title, Playoff Delta's week and season, the report's week. Recorded as C1035.
calls.undo: Change that genre's rule in TITLES in packages/video-render/src/thumbnail.ts.

calls.title: A title that doesn't fit gets no thumbnail, and the video is still made
options: skip the thumbnail, keep the video, say why
draw it smaller or in a fallback font
calls.why: The owner said a title is never drawn badly, and losing the episode over its thumbnail would cost more than the thumbnail is worth. The floor is 14px at 320 by 180. Recorded as C1036.
calls.undo: Make writeThumbnail in apps/www/tests/record/thumbnail.ts fail the render, or move LEAST_READABLE_PX.
